significance: A goddess temple on the summit of Shali Tibba at about 2,862 m, some 36 km from Shimla and reached by a seven-kilometre walk through deodar and pine. The present timber-and-stone Kath Kuni building was renovated in the early twentieth century by Raja Rana Bhupinder Singh of Bushahr, and Navratri is its chief occasion.
story: Local tradition says the goddess appeared in a dream and asked to be moved to the highest peak nearby so that her blessing would reach the whole region.
